alt_text.1: HXG title slide with a preview of six capability-to-guest-outcome pathways.
alt_text.2: J.D. Power evidence: 74 percent availability, 62 percent usage, and 44,787 branded hotel guests, with source scope and a causation caveat.
alt_text.3: Six rows connect Cast from your device to Feel at home, Control room settings to Feel in control, Connect stay context to Feel recognized, Present content accessibly to Feel included, Protect sessions and data to Feel secure, and Request services and help to Feel supported.
alt_text.4: Human outcomes flow through measurement into three property-specific value scenarios for ancillary contribution, energy, and remote support.
alt_text.5: Stakeholders are grouped by who experiences, operates, enables, and captures value, with an economic-context caveat.
alt_text.6: Samsung is shown as a vendor-stated reference architecture organized into display, experience, integration, and governance layers.
alt_text.7: Three evidence states, four contradiction findings, and the major limit that capability evidence does not prove perception or financial outcomes.
alt_text.8: Eight research stages, frozen release counts, the live HXG explorer URL, QR code, and an invitation to audit the evidence.
